essence: The color of fire born of golden seed is declared auspicious.
Knowers of tantra declare the smell of the fire to be auspicious.
The auspicious fire signs bring happiness to the sacrificer and especially to the kingdom.
A foul smell from the fire brings sorrow to the priest.
Following all tantras yields accomplishment of the ritual's intended result.
